newsitem.title: UK: Merrill Lynch leads $718 mln asset-backed bond.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch leads $718 mln asset-backed bond.

text.p: Beneficial Mortgage Corp has issued a three-tranche home equity loan asset-backed FRN for a total of $718 million, lead manager Merrill Lynch said.
